content.title: 7 New Costco Finds Selling Fast This Month
content.text: One trip to a Costco warehouse will either tell you all you need to know about how many perks come with a membership card, or leave you feeling completely overwhelmed. We get it! Thankfully, the team at Southern Living fashions ourselves somewhat of Costco experts, so we enjoy giving you highlights every single month that go beyond the warehouse savings booklet, including new products and seasonal favorites.This month, there is no shortage of hot finds on Costco shelves. Let's dive in.7 New Costco Finds For March 2026Built Sour Puff Protein and Collagen BarsPacked full of 16 grams of protein and collagen with only 150 calories, each box of 14 Built Sour Puff Protein and Collagen Bars includes retails for $19.99. Flavors include Blue Razz Blast and Sweet Peach Punch, and shoppers are already weighing in on taste."My daughter loves these! My daughter says peach taste like peach rings, blu [sic] razz like a blue [Sour Patch Kids]," one fan wrote.Oat Haus Cookie Dough Granola ButterGluten free and vegan, Oat Haus' Cookie Dough Granola Butter also has chocolate chips mixed in for the perfect sweet treat. Just $9.99 for a 27-ounce jar, one Reddit user wrote, "I'm not even sure what food you are supposed to put it on, I just use a spoon."Smart Sweets Sweet FishIf you love Swedish Fish, we have good news: their better-for-you cousin just landed at Costco. Smart Sweets' Sweet Fish, a synthetic dye-free and lower sugar alternative, is now available nationwide. Ten bags for $17.99 makes them a great Easter basket option—but act quickly!Twice Baked Chocolate CroissantsAt the end of last month, Costco rolled out Twice Baked Chocolate Croissants, and our staff did an immediate taste test. Each box of six—which retails for $9.99—features the traditional buttery and flaky croissant dough, but with a chocolate center and twice-baked to ensure extra crispiness, then dusted with chocolate crumbles and powdered sugar.Credit: Southern LivingMeredith Dairy Marinated Goat CheeseImported from Australia, this marinated goat cheese started popping up around Christmas time in select markets, but is now being rolled out at more warehouses across the South. You'll pay $15.99 for nearly 16 ounces of creamy marinated cheese that is best enjoyed on a charcuterie board. One user wrote, "Also lasts a lot longer than the standard tubes at Costco due to the olive oil."Cranberry Orange BagelsCostco's bakery is constantly rolling out delicious new items to try, and their latest is a serious breakfast upgrade. Cranberry Orange Bagels debuted at the end of February and are included in the two six-packs for $7.99 bagel deal. That's right, you can mix and match the new Cranberry Orange flavor with old favorites like Everything and Plain.SimplyProtein Kickin’ Jalapeño Ranch Protein Tortilla ChipsPacked with seven grams of plant-based protein, SimplyProtein's Kickin’ Jalapeño Ranch Protein Tortilla Chips are the perfect blend of crunch, creamy ranch, and light heat. Just $8.79 for a 15-ounce bag, some stores are already selling out. Our advice? Grab them while you can!Read the original article on Southern Living
